inputs.limitations: The 48 inputs are previously masked/inpainted screen-recording crops, not raw camera frames. Timing uses the retained screenshot converted to grayscale and scaled to 360x480.

desktop_jvm.method: before, after, after, before; separate JVMs, 20 warmups and 60 samples per stage; no JFR or concurrent builds

device_validation: Android API 36 ARM64 emulator. Physical phone unavailable over ADB; no CamScanner same-input or physical-camera end-to-end timing comparison.
